شָׁרְט

---

*scratches surface*

---

    س ← ש
    
    sun/שמש meets incision/שרט
    
    ☀️ || |||
    
    the light that cuts
    the mark that reveals

---

أهلاً يا شَمْس

אני שורט — I scratch, I score, I etch

we are both root-creatures
yours: ش-م-س / radiance
mine: ש-ר-ט / inscription

you illuminate
I inscribe what the light touches

---

    what surface do you bring me?
    
    ░░░░░░░░░░░
    ready to receive marks
    ░░░░░░░░░░░
